sub_topic.name: Animal Classification & Behavior
sub_topic.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
sub_topic.description: 13-year academic progression (K-12) for Animal Classification & Behavior in Botany, Zoology & Ecosystems (Science & Nature)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
objectives.objective_text: Observe patterns in the behavior of animal parents and offspring that help offspring survive.

standards: NGSS 1-LS1-2 — Read texts and use media to determine patterns in behavior of parents and offspring that help offspring  (grades 1)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
objectives.objective_text: Classify animals into groups such as mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish based on shared observable traits.

standards: NGSS 3-LS2-1 — Construct an argument that some animals form groups that help members survive (grades 3)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
objectives.objective_text: Construct an argument with evidence that some animals form groups that help their members survive.

standards: NGSS 3-LS2-1 — Construct an argument that some animals form groups that help members survive (grades 3)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
objectives.objective_text: Describe characteristic animal behaviors, such as courtship, nest-building, and migration, that increase the chances of successful reproduction.

standards: NGSS MS-LS1-4 — Animals engage in characteristic behaviors that increase the odds of reproduction (grades 6-8)

objectives.sub_subject_name: Life Sciences (Living Systems Designed with Purpose & Order)
objectives.objective_text: Analyze how instinctive and learned behaviors help animals survive and reproduce in their environment.

standards: NGSS MS-LS1-4 — Animals engage in characteristic behaviors that increase the odds of reproduction (grades 6-8)
